name: Extendable Cycle-Ratio Spaces Are Open
statement: If section rows $a$ extend to a positive $t$-certificate, then the open cycle-metric ball of radius $\tfrac12\log(1+t)$ about $[a]$ consists of extendable row orbits. Thus every extension space in fundamental-cycle coordinates is open. Two supplied pieces glue realizably whenever the distance between their row orbits is less than the sum of these two radii.
proof: Choose $q<\sqrt{1+t}$ for every orbit in the ball and apply robust section gluing. For two pieces, normalized coefficientwise geometric interpolation gives a cycle-ratio point strictly inside both balls.
